analysis.insight_summary: Users observed a change in how mathematical instructions function across different hardware and software versions. In [product_name] [version_no], selecting [article_no] hardware means the reference button that was available in earlier hardware versions is no longer present. This suggests issues with usability and feature continuity when updating product versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect consistent features across product versions, specifically wishing to retain the ability to select references in mathematical instructions as was possible before.
